school_level.scope: University taught-postgraduate minimum. Individual Faculty of Business programmes may add academic, experience, or interview conditions. None of the opened English-medium master's pages set an IELTS overall or TOEFL overall above this minimum.
school_level.general_entrance_text: For admission to a Doctoral degree programme, you must possess a Master's degree. As for the Master's degree or Postgraduate Diploma, the basic requirement is a Bachelor's degree from an institution that is recognised by PolyU. In addition, you must meet the entrance requirements that are specified by individual programmes. PolyU may accept equivalent qualifications. The decision is made on an individual basis.
school_level.applications_text: Applications will be considered on the basis of the information (such as academic achievements, professional qualifications and work experience) provided in the application. All applicants must fulfil the General Entrance Requirement and English Language Requirement to be considered for admission. You may also be required to attend an interview and/or test. Departments will consider applications on a rolling basis until places are filled.

english.text: If you are not a native speaker of English, and your Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is awarded by institutions where the medium of instruction is not English, you are expected to provide one of the following proficiency test results (taken in a single sitting within 2 years): an overall score of 80 out of 120 / 4.5 out of 6 (for tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026) or above in TOEFL iBT; OR an Overall Band score of 6.0 or above in IELTS Academic.
english.waiver: Native speaker of English, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent awarded by an institution where the medium of instruction is English.
